title: Capability Execution Receipt
description: Agent-neutral receipt emitted by any agent (Claude Code, Codex, KiloCode, CI) after executing a governed capability. Both Claude Code and Codex must emit this same schema — the supervisor and task-close system must not require different evidence based on agent vendor.

capability_id.description: Skill ID that was executed (e.g. S-23).

capability_version.description: Semantic version of the capability contract at execution time.

agent_type.description: Type of agent that executed the capability.

adapter_type.description: Type of adapter used to invoke the capability.

adapter_path.description: Path to the adapter file used (e.g. .claude/commands/ground-check.md).

canonical_contract.description: Path to the canonical skill contract (e.g. skills/ground-check.md).

implementation.description: Path to the backing script, if any.

task_id.description: Taskcard or plan ID this execution belongs to.

invocation.description: Full invocation string used (e.g. '/ground-check family=3d platform=python').

normalized_inputs.description: Key-value map of resolved input parameters after normalization.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when execution started.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when execution completed.

changed_paths.description: Repository-relative paths of files created or modified.

evidence_paths.description: Paths to evidence artifacts produced (e.g. frontmatter proof files).

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for detecting duplicate executions (e.g. 'S-23:family:platform:sha').

failure_reason.description: Human-readable failure reason, present when verdict is FAIL or PARTIAL.
